about_the_game:
1. Explore a New Solar System

Dive into a strange solar system where things rarely go as planned. From crashing asteroids to sudden black holes forming out of nowhere, space is anything but safe. You’ll need to sharpen your exploration skills and follow the clues to uncover hidden treasures scattered somewhere in the cosmos. Your AI companion is always nearby, offering tips and support.

2. Fight or Escape

The unknown creatures are not always friendly. Learn to use powerful bio-weapons and tools to defend yourself, or find smart ways to escape when the odds are stacked against you.

3. Gather, Build, Survive

Collect rare materials, build temporary shelters, and craft essential gear to upgrade your abilities. The better your tools, the better your chances of surviving.
